summary: OpenAI's 175-billion-parameter language model, which showed that a large enough model can do new tasks from a few examples. Offered only through an API, it was the base of ChatGPT's first model and was switched off as newer models replaced it.

events.note: OpenAI publishes the GPT-3 paper, "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners".
OpenAI opens a waiting list for its API, the only way to use GPT-3.

events.label: Microsoft
events.note: Microsoft gets an exclusive licence to the model itself.

events.label: InstructGPT
events.note: Models tuned to follow instructions become the API default.

events.label: Notice
events.note: OpenAI gives notice that the original GPT-3 models will shut down.
The original ada, babbage, curie and davinci models are shut down.

cause: Its original models were switched off in favour of newer ones.

sources.title: arXiv: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
